sentences.en: Algeria needs to speed up the transition to renewable energy.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要加快向可再生能源转型。

sentences.en: Renewable energy and deep-sea mining also offer opportunities for investment.
sentences.zh: 可再生能源和深海采矿也为投资提供了机会。

sentences.en: Algeria is only getting started with its renewable energy developments.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚的可再生能源发展才刚刚开始。

senses.zh: 可再生的；可更新的；可继续的
